Card Q&A.q: Does this card's inherited effect activate when an effect returns one of my Digimon to my hand?
I activate an effect that reads “. Then, trash 1 card in your hand.” Even though I trashed a card in my hand, does the  allow me to activate this card’s inherited effect?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an effect adds a card to your hand, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn.
